changes_from_c3r: Every partition record now included in manifest (not just counts)
Day-level granularity with per-day status tracking
Atomic manifest writes via temp file + os.replace

statuses.complete: Day data downloaded, validated, checksum computed
statuses.market_closed: Weekend or holiday, no data expected
statuses.failed: Download failed after retries, classified by failure category

monthly_compaction: Occurs only when all days reach terminal status
